title: Product of ordinary and biased monomials
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $p$ assign a real parameter to each of the $n$ coordinates, let $T$ and $S$ be subsets of the coordinate indices, and let $x$ be a vector of $n$ signs. For each coordinate $i$, write $m_i=(x_i-(1-2p_i))/\sqrt{4p_i(1-p_i)}$. The ordinary monomial on $T$ times the monomial formed from these standardized signs on $S$ equals $\prod_{i=0}^{n-1} (\mathbf{1}_{i\in T}x_i+\mathbf{1}_{i\notin T})(\mathbf{1}_{i\in S}m_i+\mathbf{1}_{i\notin S})$, where each indicator is $1$ when its condition holds and $0$ otherwise.
